build_note: The M10 port benchmark: shlex 1.3.0, the release the crates that split and quote shell words depend on, a library of two modules (src/bytes.rs and the crate root, src/lib.rs) whose unit tests are in both. It has no dependencies and doesn't commit its Cargo.lock, so bench/fetch.py commits one on top of the pinned commit ("lockfile": "generate"). fuzz/ is a separate cargo-fuzz workspace that needs libfuzzer-sys, so it stays out of the port. Edition 2015, as its manifest names none.
